messages:
kayla: Quick PR heads-up  I'm updating the HelloSpark quickstart to prefer token env vars (REDWOOD_API_KEY), add a tiny devcontainer hint, and switch the local example from `docker run` to `docker compose`. PR #4507. Need a reviewer for wording + migration note.
omar: Nice. Can you paste the updated snippets so I can skim the code blocks?
kayla: Paste: 

```
# .env
REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_XXXXX
```

```
# python example
import os
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
res = client.chat.create(model='redwood-mini', input='Hello Spark!')
print(res.text)
```

kayla: Run locally instruction added: `docker compose up --build hello-spark` so folks have one clear command.
rhea: Quick nit: add devcontainer example for VS Code Codespaces: "runArgs": ["-e","REDWOOD_API_KEY=${localEnv:REDWOOD_API_KEY}"]. Also add one sentence about storing keys in a secret manager for production.
omar: And please include a short migration blurb: "If you previously followed cookie/session examples, set REDWOOD_API_KEY in your environment; Dedicated/Private customers can continue to use session cookies (see enterprise auth docs)." Keep it calm.
kayla: Added devcontainer snippet, secret-manager note, and migration sentence with link to /enterprise/auth. Also updated examples to default to `redwood-mini` (cheap + fast). Pushed patch.
ci-bot: CI status for PR #4507: lint: passed, link-check: passed, preview: https://deploy-preview-4507--docs.redwood.ai
rhea: LGTM aside from two tiny copy edits I pushed inline. No functional changes.
omar: Approved. I'll merge after a quick staging smoke.
kayla: Thanks! I'll queue a small smoke e2e that runs the quickstart container in CI and then backfill a short migration note into the migration guide next sprint.
